is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Aedes aegypti mosquitoes: 'A total of 816 Ae. aegypti adult mosquitoes were collected across 27 locations in the capital city of Praia located in Santiago Island, Cape Verde' (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study investigated Aedes aegypti VGSC mutations V1016G/I, S989P, and F1534C (pages 4-5), none of which are target markers for Anopheles vectors.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype data for target Anopheles resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes were collected in Praia, Santiago Island, Cape Verde between August and October 2016 (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research study reporting surveillance and sequencing of field-caught mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected at specific sites with GPS coordinates in Praia, Santiago Island, Cape Verde (e.g., Tira Chapeu: 14° 55.207' N, 23° 32.323' W; Plateau: 14° 55.371' N, 23° 30.334' W; page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted 'for seven weeks from 17 August to 5 October 2016' (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard primary field collection of Aedes aegypti.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files describe primers and phylogenetic trees for Aedes aegypti and are not relevant to Anopheles resistance markers.

assessment.summary: This study monitored arbovirus infection (ZIKV, DENV), VGSC mutations (V1016G/I, S989P, F1534C), and mitochondrial nad4 haplotype diversity in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes collected in Praia, Cape Verde in 2016. No Anopheles mosquitoes were sampled or genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: Study examines Aedes aegypti, not Anopheles mosquitoes.
Does not genotype any target Anopheles insecticide resistance markers.
No extractable genotype data for target Anopheles markers.
